digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate DET lint (P6 AC quality)
propositions: A deterministic advisory lexicon lint must flag AC checklist items carrying operational-evidence markers (deploy, prod, live-run, IaC-apply, cloud-state, merge-gate, human-action, drill, store-surgery, recorded-attestation) that are not tagged [operator-attested]
The lint is implemented as an extension to p6_ac_quality within det_operator_attested.py, keeping DET_CHECKS at exactly 9 and CANONICAL_DET unchanged, with no criteria_routing.json entry added
The tag matcher _OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE must be single-sourced and shared between the plan-time lint and the completion-verifier enrichment (workflow_ops imports it from det_operator_attested)

The deterministic self-gate eval on the frozen historical AC corpus from 556 E1 outcome-corpus tickets must achieve precision ≥70% on a ≥50-item sample, flag rate ≤5%, and both known cases (115b, 8c4f) must fire
The eval harness and frozen corpus results are committed before the lint activation, with git-ancestry verifying the eval commit is an ancestor of the activation commit

The implementation must pass all unit tests including known-case fixtures and agreement tests, stay advisory with no blocking posture, and remain unaffected by module-size constraints through dedicated module extraction
